quality.rationale: Open P2 backlog is implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes Quick Add line creation, duplicate Add line removal from Layers, grouped row and preview selection, repeated group creation, confirmed-position canvas drag undo/redo, palette maker preview, generated palette group blocks, CSV/HTML persistence, WebP export, mobile no-overflow, user-facing docs, and QCDS evidence. Cross-browser, real-device, and browser storage quota edge cases remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, and browser-local edit state, template, color, and custom font storage.

delivery.rationale: TODO and local Issues are closed, implementation and docs are aligned, README and user guide are present, QCDS evidence is recorded, tests/build/runtime gate pass, and docs packaging remains available through the existing workflow. A fresh remote Pages run after this commit remains pending until pushed.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested improvements passed: line creation moved into Quick Add, Layers no longer exposes a duplicate Add line button, repeated group creation works, grouped rows are folder-like, grouped preview objects select the whole group, Colors has a palette maker with grouped generated palettes, canvas drag undo/redo returns only to confirmed positions, CSV/HTML import/export persistence works, WebP export works, and QCDS evidence is updated. Remaining satisfaction risk is storage quota behavior, broader real-user font files, and non-Chromium browser coverage.
